hooks.command: if [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ]; then bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/deploy/cloud-session/toolchain.sh; else { cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && mise x uv -- uv run --frozen dispatch-hook session-start; } || echo '`dispatch audit` did not start at session start (dispatch.md §2.2)'; fi
[ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] || { cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && mise x uv -- uv run --frozen dispatch-hook agent; }
[ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] || { cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && mise x uv -- uv run --frozen dispatch-hook handback; }
[ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] || { cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && mise x uv -- uv run --frozen dispatch-hook pr-create; }
